Aatrox.watch: Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade deals his main damage and knocks you up, so watch his cast animation and dodge beyond the blade’s edge or move in close. If Aatrox W Infernal Chains hits you, leave its area immediately and save Gwen E Skip 'n Slash in case you’re pulled back. Aatrox R World Ender increases his healing, so keep your distance until it ends.
Aatrox.build: Build armor first to counter the physical damage from Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains. If a long duel turns in Aatrox’s favor because of his healing, get healing reduction with Morellonomicon.
Aatrox.fight: Trade right after Aatrox uses his Deathbringer Stance empowered basic attack on a minion. Fully stack Gwen Q Snip Snip! first, dodge the edge of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade as you move in, and keep Aatrox in the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!. Don’t continue the duel while Aatrox R World Ender is active.
Aatrox.laning: Don’t force early trades. Farm and gain levels without giving Aatrox a kill. Stack Gwen Q Snip Snip! on minions in advance, and save Gwen W Hallowed Mist for gank defense while pushing the lane.
Aatrox.combo: Fully stack Gwen Q Snip Snip! by basic attacking minions or Aatrox. If Aatrox backs away, slow him with the first cast of Gwen R Needlework, then close the gap with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash and land empowered basic attacks. Keep Aatrox in the center of the cone when you cast Gwen Q Snip Snip!, then follow up with Gwen R Needlework while he remains in range.
Aatrox.escape: Aatrox E Umbral Dash gives you a chance to close the gap with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash right after he uses it. However, if Aatrox W Infernal Chains hits you, use Gwen E Skip 'n Slash to leave its area before you’re pulled back. When Aatrox R World Ender is active, back off and reengage after it ends.
Aatrox.phase: Early on, it’s hard to stack Gwen Q Snip Snip!, so your trades are weak, and giving Aatrox an advantage can let him snowball. If you preserve your farm and levels, Gwen becomes strong in duels from mid game as you build ability power items. In late game, use Gwen’s max-health damage to fight the frontline directly.
Aatrox.teamfight: Fight the frontline and deal Gwen Q Snip Snip!’s true damage from its center. Engage with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash when Aatrox’s key crowd control is down or Gwen W Hallowed Mist is ready. Use Gwen W Hallowed Mist to gain armor and withstand focused attacks.

Akali.watch: Prioritize dodging the first hit of Akali E Shuriken Flip. If it marks you, she can follow up with a second dash, so save Gwen E Skip 'n Slash to dodge the first hit or respond to Akali R Perfect Execution’s engage. The second hit of Akali R Perfect Execution deals more damage based on your missing health, so don’t let the fight drag on when your health is low.
Akali.build: Build magic resistance first to counter Akali’s main damage, and get some health as well. Akali’s high magic resistance can blunt Gwen’s magic damage, so add penetration and make use of Gwen Q Snip Snip!’s true damage from the center.
Akali.fight: Stack Gwen Q Snip Snip! with basic attacks, then fight after dodging the first hit of Akali E Shuriken Flip or once Akali R Perfect Execution is down. If Akali comes out of Akali W Twilight Shroud to attack, fight back. When she briefly reveals herself, hit her with the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!.
Akali.combo: Stack Gwen Q Snip Snip! first by basic attacking minions or Akali. If she’s far away, slow her with the first cast of Gwen R Needlework, then close the gap with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash and land an empowered basic attack. Keep Akali in the center when you cast Gwen Q Snip Snip!. Follow up with Gwen R Needlework when you can keep her in range.
Akali.escape: If the first hit of Akali E Shuriken Flip missed and Akali R Perfect Execution isn’t back up yet, close the gap with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash. If only Akali W Twilight Shroud is down, she may still have another way to move, so don’t rush your engage.
Akali.phase: It’s hard to stack, so prioritize scaling. Gwen becomes strong in duels from mid game as you build ability power items, and in late game use her max-health damage to fight the frontline.
Akali.teamfight: Fight the frontline and deal Gwen Q Snip Snip!’s true damage from the center. Engage with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash when the opponent’s key crowd control is down or Gwen W Hallowed Mist is ready, and use Gwen W Hallowed Mist to withstand focused attacks.

Aurora.build: Prioritize magic resistance over armor to counter the damage from Aurora P Spirit Abjuration, Q Twofold Hex, and E The Weirding. If Aurora’s healing can turn a duel, get healing reduction with Morellonomicon. Gwen W Hallowed Mist also increases Gwen’s magic resistance while active.
Aurora.fight: Stack Gwen Q Snip Snip! with basic attacks, then close the gap with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash. If Aurora backs away, use the increased range of E’s empowered basic attack to go for one more rotation.
Aurora.laning: Prepare your stacks. After learning Gwen W Hallowed Mist, trade while using it to avoid Aurora’s poke. Save W for gank defense while pushing the lane.
Aurora.combo: Stack Gwen Q Snip Snip! first by basic attacking minions or Aurora. If she’s far away, slow her with the first cast of Gwen R Needlework, then close the gap with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash and land an empowered basic attack and a center hit of Q. Watch whether Aurora stays in range and follow up with R’s remaining hits.
Aurora.escape: Make Aurora use E The Weirding or W Across the Veil, check whether she has another way to move, then reengage. If both Aurora E and W are down and R Between Worlds isn’t back up yet, you have a chance to close the gap with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash. Wait briefly while Aurora W Across the Veil keeps her hidden, then attack when she reappears.
Aurora.phase: Early on, Gwen’s trades are weak because she lacks Q stacks, so focus on scaling. After learning Gwen W Hallowed Mist, you can use it to avoid Aurora’s poke, and Gwen becomes strong in duels from mid game as you build ability power items. In late game, use her max-health damage to attack the frontline.
Aurora.teamfight: Fight the frontline and land Gwen Q Snip Snip!’s center hit, using Gwen W Hallowed Mist to withstand focused attacks. If Aurora leaps in but doesn’t secure a takedown, look for a chance to catch her. When Aurora gets a takedown, her leap ability’s cooldown resets, so don’t leave low-health allies behind as you retreat.
Aurora.watch: Aurora Q Twofold Hex deals damage again when recalled, and the recall damage increases as your health gets lower. If you’re cursed, move out of the line between you and Aurora. If you are unsure you have enough health, back off before it is recalled. After Aurora R Between Worlds appears, you’re slowed when leaving it, so decide whether to retreat before the zone appears or fight inside it.

Camille.watch: Camille E Hookshot travels along walls to engage from far away and stun you, so stand away from walls and dodge the dash with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash when you see it coming. The second empowered basic attack from Camille Q Precision Protocol deals some true damage, which armor can’t block, so create distance while she prepares that hit. Camille can’t be targeted during the cast of R The Hextech Ultimatum, so don’t waste your counter ability then.
Camille.build: Build armor first to counter the physical damage from Camille Q Precision Protocol, W Tactical Sweep, and E Hookshot. Camille Q Precision Protocol’s true damage can’t be reduced by resistances, and Camille W Tactical Sweep deals max-health damage, so be careful about relying on health alone. If Camille W Tactical Sweep’s healing can turn a duel, get healing reduction with Morellonomicon.
Camille.fight: Stack Gwen Q Snip Snip! and trade after Camille P Adaptive Defenses’ shield has been removed. Create distance while Camille prepares her second empowered basic attack from Q Precision Protocol. If Camille is outside the mist, use Gwen W Hallowed Mist to avoid that attack. When you move back in, cast Gwen Q Snip Snip! with Camille in its center.
Camille.laning: It’s hard to stack, so don’t force an engage; focus on farm and levels. Stand between minions and away from walls to limit Camille E Hookshot’s engage angles. Look for lane priority before Camille completes her first core item, but save Gwen W Hallowed Mist for gank defense while pushing.
Camille.combo: Stack Gwen Q Snip Snip! first by basic attacking minions or Camille. If Camille moves away, slow her with the first cast of Gwen R Needlework, close the gap with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash, and land an empowered basic attack. Then cast Gwen Q Snip Snip! with Camille in the center. Follow up with Gwen R Needlework while Camille remains in range.
Camille.escape: When Camille E Hookshot is down, you have a chance to close the gap with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash. However, Camille can also use R The Hextech Ultimatum to move, so look to engage when both abilities are down or before Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum is back up.
Camille.phase: In mid game, Gwen becomes strong in duels as she builds ability power items, but Camille can quickly destroy towers in a side lane, so don’t leave the side lane open. In late game, use Gwen’s max-health damage to fight the frontline.
Camille.teamfight: Attack the frontline and deal Gwen Q Snip Snip!’s true damage from the center. Engage with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash when the opponent’s key crowd control is down or Gwen W Hallowed Mist is ready. Be careful about engaging while Camille E Hookshot’s stun is available. If Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum traps you, wait out the zone’s duration, then counterattack.

Chogath.watch: When you see the ground warning for Cho'Gath Q Rupture beneath your feet, move to the side and, if needed, dodge with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash. If Cho'Gath W Feral Scream silences you, you cannot use mobility abilities, so stay out of its frontal area and focus on walking while silenced. Cho'Gath R Feast deals true damage, so create distance if your health is at or below half.
Chogath.build: Build magic resistance first to prepare for the magic damage from Cho'Gath Q Rupture, W Feral Scream, and E Vorpal Spikes. If Cho'Gath P Carnivore's healing turns the duel around, get healing reduction with Morellonomicon. You cannot reduce the true damage from Cho'Gath R Feast with resistances.
Chogath.fight: When Cho'Gath Q Rupture misses, close in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash and trade. Circle to the side to avoid the front of Cho'Gath W Feral Scream, then use Gwen Q Snip Snip! with Cho'Gath in the center of the cone after stacking it with basic attacks.
Chogath.combo: Stack Gwen Q Snip Snip! first by basic attacking minions or Cho'Gath. If Cho'Gath moves away, slow him with the first cast of Gwen R Needlework, close in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash, and land an empowered basic attack, then use Gwen Q Snip Snip! with Cho'Gath in the center. Continue casting Gwen R Needlework if Cho'Gath remains in range.
Chogath.escape: Go in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash when Cho'Gath Q Rupture misses or is used on the wave, and Cho'Gath W Feral Scream is also on cooldown. Cho'Gath has no mobility, so he will struggle to create distance if you engage then. If your health is at or below half, do not engage because of the true damage from Cho'Gath R Feast.
Chogath.phase: Gwen's dueling becomes strong from mid game as ability power items accumulate, while Cho'Gath becomes harder to deal with over time as he stacks. In late game, use Gwen's maximum-health damage to attack frontline champions like Cho'Gath directly, but avoid being killed by Cho'Gath R Feast when health is borderline.
Chogath.teamfight: Gwen attacks frontline champions like Cho'Gath directly. Engage with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash when key crowd control like Cho'Gath Q Rupture and W Feral Scream is on cooldown, or when Gwen W Hallowed Mist is ready. Withstand focused attacks using Gwen W Hallowed Mist and hit Gwen Q Snip Snip! with Cho'Gath in the center.
Chogath.laning: While behind minions, stay out of the straight line along which Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes extend, and pressure him after Cho'Gath Q Rupture is used on the wave. Save Gwen W Hallowed Mist to respond to ganks while pushing the lane.

Darius.watch: If you are pulled by Darius E Apprehend, he can follow with basic attacks, Darius W Crippling Strike, and Darius Q Decimate, so wait outside its range. When you see Darius Q Decimate, move outside the blade or stay close to his body to reduce its damage and healing. Create distance while Darius P Hemorrhage stacks; if several stacks are applied and your health is low, get completely out of range of Darius R Noxian Guillotine.
Darius.build: Build armor first to prepare for the physical damage from Darius P Hemorrhage, Q Decimate, and W Crippling Strike. Darius E Apprehend's penetration bypasses some armor, and armor does not work against the true damage from Darius R Noxian Guillotine, so also consider your total health. If the healing from Darius Q Decimate turns the duel around, get healing reduction with Morellonomicon.
Darius.fight: Make short hit-and-run trades when Darius E Apprehend misses or is unavailable to use again. Right after Darius Q Decimate is used to clear minions is also an opportunity to poke. When Hemorrhage starts stacking, do not extend the trade; back off to break the stacks.
Darius.laning: Early on, farm and gain levels outside Darius E Apprehend's range, and do not force an engage. Stack Gwen Q Snip Snip! by basic attacking minions, then trade after Darius E Apprehend is used. Save Gwen W Hallowed Mist while pushing the lane so you can respond to a gank.
Darius.combo: Stack Gwen Q Snip Snip! by basic attacking minions or Darius. Once Darius E Apprehend is used, close in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash, land an empowered basic attack, and use Gwen Q Snip Snip! with Darius in the center of the cone. If you need more range, slow him with the first cast of Gwen R Needlework, then approach with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash.
Darius.escape: Go in when Darius E Apprehend misses or is unavailable to recast. While Darius E Apprehend is ready, save Gwen E Skip 'n Slash so you can respond to it.
Darius.phase: It is hard to stack, so your trades are weak, while Darius is strong in early skirmishes. Gwen's dueling becomes strong in mid game as ability power items accumulate, so use the window when Darius E Apprehend is on cooldown. In late game, Gwen can face frontline champions directly with her maximum-health damage, but avoid extended trades that let Darius stack Hemorrhage.
Darius.teamfight: Gwen's role is to hit frontline champions with the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!'s cone. Engage with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash when Darius E Apprehend is on cooldown or Gwen W Hallowed Mist is ready. If Darius kills you with Darius R Noxian Guillotine while you have several Hemorrhage stacks, its cooldown resets, so fully disengage if your health is dangerously low.

Fiora.watch: Fiora moves toward the direction of the vital from Fiora P Duelist's Dance, so stand on the opposite side to narrow her approach angle. Fiora W Riposte negates attacks and strikes back, so dodge its direction with lateral movement when using Gwen Q Snip Snip! or Gwen R Needlework. If you are hit by Fiora R Grand Challenge, stand against a wall to block one side's vital.
Fiora.build: Build armor first, accounting for the physical damage from Fiora Q Lunge and E Bladework. You cannot reduce the true damage from Fiora P Duelist's Dance and R Grand Challenge with armor. If healing makes the duel drag on, build resistances, then get healing reduction with Morellonomicon.
Fiora.fight: Trade briefly while avoiding the vital's direction, and do not chase recklessly if Fiora backs off. Close the distance with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash right after Fiora uses Q Lunge, but do not use your key attacks immediately if Fiora W Riposte is ready. Once Riposte has been fully spent, attack with Fiora in the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!'s cone.
Fiora.laning: Prepare stacks for Gwen Q Snip Snip! by attacking minions, and counterattack when Fiora dives toward a vital. Save Gwen W Hallowed Mist while pushing the lane to prepare for a gank.
Fiora.combo: First, stack Gwen Q Snip Snip! with basic attacks. When Fiora Q Lunge is on cooldown, close in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash and land an empowered basic attack, dodge the counterstrike from Fiora W Riposte with lateral movement, then hit the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!. Continue using Gwen R Needlework when its first cast slow can keep Fiora in range.
Fiora.escape: Right after you bait out Fiora Q Lunge is a window to engage with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash. If Fiora W Riposte is on cooldown, it is also a good time to use Gwen Q Snip Snip! and Gwen R Needlework. Be cautious about engaging where there is no target for Gwen E Skip 'n Slash to hit initially, as its cooldown will run for its full duration.
Fiora.phase: Early on, Gwen's trades are weak because she lacks stacks for Gwen Q Snip Snip!, so focus on scaling. Gwen's dueling becomes strong from mid game as ability power items accumulate.
Fiora.teamfight: If you are hit by Fiora R Grand Challenge, stand against a wall so you do not expose all four vitals. Gwen engages with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash when the opponent's key crowd control is on cooldown or Gwen W Hallowed Mist is ready. Use the mist to withstand focused attacks and deal the center damage of Gwen Q Snip Snip! to the frontline.

Gangplank.watch: Gangplank E Powder Keg slows when it explodes, so avoid primed kegs and areas where two kegs overlap. If you can destroy a keg from outside the explosion range, do so. You cannot reduce the true damage from Gangplank P Trial by Fire and R Cannon Barrage with resistances.
Gangplank.build: Build armor first, starting in lane, to prepare for the poke from Gangplank Q Parrrley and the physical damage from Gangplank E Powder Keg. If the healing from Gangplank W Remove Scurvy turns a long duel around, get healing reduction with Morellonomicon.
Gangplank.fight: Trade when Gangplank has just placed Gangplank E Powder Keg and there are no primed kegs nearby. With Gwen Q Snip Snip! stacks prepared in advance, close in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash, and use the armor bonus from Gwen W Hallowed Mist to withstand physical damage from Gangplank Q Parrrley.
Gangplank.laning: Prepare your stacks. Back off when Gangplank E Powder Keg is primed, and save Gwen W Hallowed Mist to respond to a gank while pushing the lane.
Gangplank.combo: Stack Gwen Q Snip Snip! by basic attacking minions or Gangplank. Close in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash and land an empowered basic attack, then use Gwen Q Snip Snip! with Gangplank in the center of the cone. If he is far away, slow him with the first cast of Gwen R Needlework, then close the distance with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash.
Gangplank.escape: Gangplank has no ability to create distance on his own, so engage with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash when there are no primed Gangplank E Powder Kegs nearby. Right after Gangplank places Gangplank E Powder Keg is a good opportunity; if a keg is primed, delay your engage.
Gangplank.phase: Early on, Gwen's trades are weak because she lacks stacks for Gwen Q Snip Snip!, so focus on scaling. Her dueling becomes strong in mid game as ability power items accumulate. In late game, use the maximum-health damage from Gwen P A Thousand Cuts to deal with the frontline.
Gangplank.teamfight: In teamfights, engage with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash when Gwen W Hallowed Mist is ready or the opponent's key crowd control is on cooldown. Hit the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip! on the frontline, then continue using Gwen R Needlework.

DrMundo.watch: Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw hits only the first target and deals damage based on current health while slowing. Be especially careful when you have high health, and avoid it by keeping minions between you. Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage increases his healing and movement speed, so don’t force a kill while it’s active.
DrMundo.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma. If Dr. Mundo’s healing turns around extended duels, get healing reduction with Morellonomicon. Gwen can keep healing reduction up by chaining auto attacks and Gwen Q Snip Snip!.
DrMundo.laning: Dr. Mundo has low magic resistance early, so look to win trades with stacks prepared. When pushing the lane, save Gwen W Hallowed Mist to respond to ganks.
DrMundo.combo: Before closing in, hit a minion or Dr. Mundo with auto attacks to build stacks for Gwen Q Snip Snip!. If he’s far away, slow him with the first cast of Gwen R Needlework, close in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash, and land an empowered auto attack. Cast Gwen Q Snip Snip! with Dr. Mundo in the center, then continue using Gwen R Needlework if he remains in range.
DrMundo.escape: Dr. Mundo has no skill to create distance on his own, so use Gwen E Skip 'n Slash to close the gap when you see an opening. It’s easier to engage without worrying about the slow after Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw is blocked by a minion. Look for kills or objectives while Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is unavailable.
DrMundo.phase: In the mid game, Gwen’s dueling gets stronger as she builds ability power items, so fight with stacks prepared. In the late game, use the max-health damage from Gwen P A Thousand Cuts to deal directly with frontliners like Dr. Mundo.
DrMundo.teamfight: Gwen attacks Dr. Mundo on the frontline and lands the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip! for its true damage. Engage with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash when the enemy’s key crowd control is down or Gwen W Hallowed Mist is ready. If Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is active, don’t spend too long trying to kill him; look for another advantage.
DrMundo.fight: Fully stack Gwen Q Snip Snip! with basic attacks before starting a fight. Block Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw with minions, then close in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash and use Gwen Q Snip Snip! with Dr. Mundo in its center. Time Gwen W Hallowed Mist for Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma’s empowered basic attack, and fight inside the mist.

Garen.watch: Garen Q Decisive Strike’s empowered auto attack silences, so don’t engage first while he has it ready. Staying too long inside Garen E Judgment’s spin puts you at a disadvantage, so trade briefly and back off. If your health is below half, stay out of range of Garen R Demacian Justice, which deals true damage based on your missing health.
Garen.fight: Start a short trade just after Garen Q Decisive Strike’s empowered auto attack is used. Build stacks with auto attacks beforehand, close in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash and land an empowered auto attack, then cast Gwen Q Snip Snip! with Garen in the center. Don’t unleash your combo right after Garen W Courage activates; wait half a beat.
Garen.laning: When Garen Q Decisive Strike is used on a minion or its empowered auto attack is spent, pressure him briefly to limit his time to build stacks for Garen W Courage. When pushing the lane, save Gwen W Hallowed Mist to respond to ganks.
Garen.combo: Build stacks for Gwen Q Snip Snip! with auto attacks, then close in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash and land an empowered auto attack after Garen Q Decisive Strike is down. Avoid the moment just after Garen W Courage’s shield activates, and deal true damage with Gwen Q Snip Snip! with Garen in the center. If you need to chase, slow him with the first cast of Gwen R Needlework before closing in, then continue using it while Garen remains in range.
Garen.escape: Garen has no mobility skill, so the moment after Garen Q Decisive Strike’s empowered auto attack is spent is your chance to go in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash. Conversely, don’t engage while Garen Q Decisive Strike is ready, as his silence can prevent you from fighting back. If Garen E Judgment is spinning, don’t stay close longer; move out of its range.
Garen.phase: Gwen has a hard time building stacks for Gwen Q Snip Snip! early, so focus on scaling, but pressure Garen’s stack growth when it’s safe. Gwen’s dueling gets stronger from the mid game as she builds ability power items. In the late game, Gwen can melt frontliners with her max-health damage, but Garen also builds permanent stacks for Garen W Courage, so keep watching for his execution range.
Garen.teamfight: Gwen faces the frontline and deals true damage by hitting the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!. Engage with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash when the enemy’s key crowd control is down or Gwen W Hallowed Mist is ready. Don’t pour in damage right after Garen W Courage activates, and get out of range if your health gets low enough for Garen R Demacian Justice to execute you.
Garen.build: Build armor first, since Garen’s main damage from Garen Q Decisive Strike and Garen E Judgment is physical. Garen E Judgment shreds armor, and Garen R Demacian Justice deals true damage, so do not remain inside his spin or within execution range on the strength of your resistances alone. If Garen P Perseverance’s healing can turn the duel, get healing reduction with Morellonomicon.

Gnar.build: Build armor first against Gnar’s main damage from Q Boomerang Throw / Boulder Toss, E Hop / Crunch, and R GNAR!. Gnar W Hyper / Wallop’s magic damage is not blocked by armor and scales with max health, so be cautious about choices that add a lot of health alone.
Gnar.fight: Start a fight after Mini Gnar uses E Hop / Crunch or just after Mega Gnar turns back into Mini Gnar. Hit minions to build stacks for Gwen Q Snip Snip!, close in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash and land an empowered auto attack, then keep Gnar in the center of Q. Activate Gwen W Hallowed Mist so that Gnar is outside the mist when he retaliates.
Gnar.laning: Move out of the round-trip path of Mini Gnar Q Boomerang Throw. After learning Gwen W Hallowed Mist, use the mist to avoid ranged poke while preparing stacks for Q. When pushing the lane, save W to respond to ganks.
Gnar.combo: First, build stacks for Gwen Q Snip Snip! by hitting a minion or Gnar with auto attacks. If he’s far away, slow him with the first cast of Gwen R Needlework, then close in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash, land an empowered auto attack, and cast Q with Gnar in the center. Continue using R while Gnar remains in range.
Gnar.phase: Gwen is weak in fights early because it’s hard to build stacks for Q, so prioritize scaling. In the mid game, Gwen’s dueling gets stronger as she builds ability power items, so look for an opening just after Gnar turns from Mega into Mini. In the late game, Gwen can deal directly with frontliners using her max-health damage.
Gnar.teamfight: Watch Gnar’s rage bar and look to start a team fight just after he turns from Mega into Mini. Avoid angles where Gnar R GNAR! can hit you with your back to a wall or in narrow terrain. When the enemy’s key crowd control is down or Gwen W Hallowed Mist is ready, Gwen engages with E Skip 'n Slash and hits the frontline with the center of Q Snip Snip!.
Gnar.escape: Close the gap with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash right after you force Gnar to use Gnar E Hop / Crunch. Avoid fighting head-on just after Gnar transforms into Mega Gnar, and engage during the window after he reverts to Mini Gnar, when he can’t transform again yet. Avoid engaging with your back to a wall so you can dodge the stun from Gnar R GNAR!.
Gnar.watch: Watch out for the slows from Gnar Q Boomerang Throw / Boulder Toss, and dodge Mini Gnar’s boomerang on its return path too. When Mega Gnar approaches, use Gwen R Needlework’s slow to create distance, and do not stand with your back to a wall, where Gnar R GNAR! could knock you into it.

Illaoi.watch: Illaoi E Test of Spirit slows and marks you, so last-hit from outside its range and dodge it with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash when it flies toward you. While Illaoi R Leap of Faith is active, don’t fight near the tentacles; create distance. Illaoi W Harsh Lesson deals max-health damage, so don’t try to survive by stacking health alone.
Illaoi.build: Build armor first because Illaoi’s main damage is physical. If the healing from Illaoi P Prophet of an Elder God turns around duels, get healing reduction with Morellonomicon.
Illaoi.fight: Dodge Illaoi E Test of Spirit, then close the gap with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash right after Illaoi uses W Harsh Lesson. Don’t fight near walls with tentacles; use the armor increase from Gwen W Hallowed Mist and keep Illaoi in the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!.
Illaoi.laning: Don’t force an engage early; focus on CS and levels. Keep the wave away from walls and last-hit from outside the range of Illaoi E Test of Spirit. When pushing the lane, save Gwen W Hallowed Mist to respond to ganks.
Illaoi.combo: First, hit minions with auto attacks to build stacks for Gwen Q Snip Snip!. When Illaoi W Harsh Lesson is down, close in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash, land an empowered auto attack, and cast Gwen Q Snip Snip! with Illaoi in the center. If it’s hard to close the gap, slow her with the first cast of Gwen R Needlework before engaging, then continue using it when you can keep her in range.
Illaoi.escape: The moment after you make Illaoi use her mobility skill, Illaoi W Harsh Lesson, is your window to engage. If you’ve also dodged Illaoi E Test of Spirit, go in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash and start a trade.
Illaoi.phase: Gwen’s trades are weak early because it’s hard to build stacks for Gwen Q Snip Snip!, so focus on scaling. Her dueling gets stronger from the mid game as she builds ability power items, and in the late game she faces frontliners with the max-health damage from Gwen P A Thousand Cuts and Gwen R Needlework.
Illaoi.teamfight: Don’t group up in front of Illaoi, and spread out during the brief burst window when Illaoi R Leap of Faith is active to reduce the number of targets she can hit. Destroy tentacles when you can; if that’s difficult, draw Illaoi away from the walls. When Gwen can engage, use Gwen E Skip 'n Slash and Gwen W Hallowed Mist to get onto the frontline and hit the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!.

Irelia.watch: Irelia can chain Irelia Q Bladesurge through low-health minions to close the gap, so keep your distance when minions are about to die. Watch out for the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet. If you get trapped by Irelia R Vanguard's Edge, wait until the blades disappear.
Irelia.build: If the healing from Irelia Q Bladesurge can turn a duel around, prioritize getting healing reduction with Morellonomicon. Gwen can stay close and keep applying healing reduction with basic attacks and Gwen Q Snip Snip!. The data does not specify Irelia’s damage type, so you can’t determine which resistance to prioritize.
Irelia.fight: Build stacks of Gwen Q Snip Snip! with basic attacks before fighting. Right after baiting out Irelia Q Bladesurge, close the gap with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash, follow up with an empowered basic attack, then hit the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!. If Irelia holds out with Irelia W Defiant Dance, aim for the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip! to deal true damage.
Irelia.laning: Don’t leave low-health minions between you and Irelia, and back away when minions are about to die. When pushing the lane, save Gwen W Hallowed Mist to respond to ganks.
Irelia.combo: Build stacks of Gwen Q Snip Snip! by basic attacking, even minions. Once Irelia Q Bladesurge is down, close in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash, land an empowered basic attack, then cast Gwen Q Snip Snip! with Irelia in the center. If you need to close the gap first, slow her with the first cast of Gwen R Needlework, then use Gwen E Skip 'n Slash to get in range.
Irelia.escape: Right after baiting out Irelia Q Bladesurge is your chance to engage with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash. It’s also a good time to go in if Irelia E Flawless Duet’s stun is down. Once you’re in, use Gwen W Hallowed Mist to withstand Irelia’s counterattack.
Irelia.phase: Gwen’s dueling gets stronger from mid game, as she builds up ability power items. In the late game, use her percent-max-health damage to attack the frontline.
Irelia.teamfight: When a team fight starts, prioritize Irelia while watching out for the AoE slow from Irelia R Vanguard's Edge and the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet. Engage with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash when Irelia’s stun is down or Gwen W Hallowed Mist is ready. Use Gwen W Hallowed Mist to withstand focused attacks and hit the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!.

Jayce.watch: When you see Jayce E Acceleration Gate, sidestep the line where Jayce Q Shock Blast will travel. When Jayce switches to hammer form, watch out for the leap from Jayce Q To the Skies! and the knockback from Jayce E Thundering Blow. His first basic attack after switching weapons reduces your resistances, so avoid that hit.
Jayce.build: Prioritize magic resistance against the magic damage from Jayce W Lightning Field and Jayce E Thundering Blow. Magic resistance cannot block the physical damage from Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast. Jayce E Thundering Blow deals percent-max-health damage, so get movement speed to escape its telegraphed area instead of stacking a lot of health alone.
Jayce.fight: Don’t force your way in early. Build stacks of Gwen Q Snip Snip! with basic attacks, then trade. Once Jayce Q To the Skies!’s leap is down, close the gap with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash, use Gwen W Hallowed Mist to avoid Jayce’s counterattack, and keep him in the center of Q.
Jayce.laning: When Jayce is in cannon form, move side to side to dodge Jayce Q Shock Blast and collect CS and levels. If you fall behind early, don’t force a comeback; farm defensively. When pushing the lane, save Gwen W Hallowed Mist to respond to ganks.
Jayce.combo: Build stacks of Gwen Q Snip Snip! by basic attacking minions first. If Jayce’s leap is down, slow him with the first cast of Gwen R Needlework, close in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash, and land an empowered basic attack; then keep Jayce in the center and cast Q. Follow up with the remaining casts of R when you can keep him in range.
Jayce.escape: Right after baiting out Jayce Q To the Skies!’s leap is your window to engage with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash. If Jayce E Thundering Blow’s knockback is also down, you’ll have an even better chance to stay on him. Gwen E Skip 'n Slash’s cooldown is significantly reduced when it hits, so check that you have a target to hit when engaging.
Jayce.phase: Gwen can respond to ranged poke after learning Gwen W Hallowed Mist, and her dueling gets stronger from mid game as she builds up ability power items. In the late game, melt the enemy frontline with percent-max-health damage.
Jayce.teamfight: Gwen fights the frontline by engaging with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash, using Gwen W Hallowed Mist to avoid focused attacks, then hitting the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!. If Jayce is in range with Jayce Q To the Skies!’s leap down, that’s a chance to close in. Engage when the enemy’s key crowd control is down or W is ready.

Jax.watch: While Jax E Counter Strike is active, Gwen’s basic attacks are dodged, and the recast damage increases with each attack, so stop basic attacking. If Jax uses Jax Q Leap Strike to enter the stun range of Jax E Counter Strike, use Gwen E Skip 'n Slash to create distance.
Jax.build: Jax relies on basic attacks and attack speed for damage, so consider prioritizing an effect that reduces attack speed for your first defensive purchase. Jax Q Leap Strike deals physical damage, while Jax W Empower and Jax E Counter Strike deal magic damage, so consider both armor and magic resistance. Jax E Counter Strike deals percent-max-health damage, so avoid choices that only add a large amount of health.
Jax.fight: Start trading after Jax E Counter Strike is down. Build stacks of Gwen Q Snip Snip! by attacking minions, land the empowered basic attack from Gwen E Skip 'n Slash, then keep Jax in the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!.
Jax.laning: Build stacks and apply pressure while Jax E Counter Strike is down. While pushing the lane, save Gwen W Hallowed Mist to guard against ganks.
Jax.combo: First, build stacks of Gwen Q Snip Snip! by basic attacking minions. When Jax E Counter Strike ends, close in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash, land an empowered basic attack, then cast Gwen Q Snip Snip! with Jax in the center of the cone. If he’s too far away, slow him with the first cast of Gwen R Needlework before engaging.
Jax.escape: While Jax has Jax E Counter Strike active, save Gwen E Skip 'n Slash to disengage and move outside the stun range. Once Jax Q Leap Strike and Jax E Counter Strike are down, close the gap again with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash.
Jax.phase: Gwen’s dueling gets stronger from mid game as she builds up ability power items. In the late game, use percent-max-health damage against the frontline.
Jax.teamfight: If Jax engages with Jax E Counter Strike active, don’t group up nearby; keep your distance until the AoE stun ends. Then close in on the frontline with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash and use Gwen W Hallowed Mist to avoid focused attacks from outside the mist while hitting the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!.

KSante.watch: If you’ve been hit repeatedly by K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes, back out of range or save Gwen E Skip 'n Slash to dodge the next pull and stun. When K'Sante W Path Maker is charged, it reduces incoming damage, so don’t commit your damage; sidestep the direction of his dash. Don’t stand with a wall behind you when facing him, so K'Sante R All Out can’t knock you through one.
KSante.build: Building ability power items strengthens Gwen’s mid-game dueling, and her primarily magic damage works well against K'Sante’s low magic resistance. Prioritize armor against K'Sante’s physical damage, and withstand the true damage from K'Sante W Path Maker with health. The data does not specify a first purchase item, so one can’t be determined.
KSante.fight: Start the fight after building stacks of Gwen Q Snip Snip! with basic attacks. K'Sante takes reduced damage while charging K'Sante W Path Maker, so dodge the dash before dealing damage, and keep him in the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!. K'Sante’s resistances drop when he uses K'Sante R All Out, creating a chance to counterattack, but his damage and life steal also increase, so don’t tank his attacks alone for long.
KSante.laning: Don’t force an engage with too few stacks; focus on CS and levels. Build stacks by attacking minions, but since K'Sante can also empower K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes using minions, check the stacks displayed on the champion. When pushing the lane, save Gwen W Hallowed Mist to respond to ganks.
KSante.combo: Build stacks of Gwen Q Snip Snip! with basic attacks, then close the gap with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash and land an empowered basic attack. Keep K'Sante in the center of the cone and cast Gwen Q Snip Snip!. If starting from far away, slow him with the first cast of Gwen R Needlework, close in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash, and follow up with the remaining casts when you can keep him in range.
KSante.escape: Engage after dodging the pull and stun from K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes and after K'Sante W Path Maker is down. K'Sante E Footwork can still let him escape, so check whether he has used it. In particular, close the gap with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash before K'Sante R All Out comes back up.
KSante.teamfight: Engage when key crowd control like K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes and K'Sante W Path Maker is down, or when Gwen W Hallowed Mist is ready. Close in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash and use Gwen W Hallowed Mist to withstand focused attacks from outside the mist, then attack with K'Sante in the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!. To counter the life steal while K'Sante is in K'Sante R All Out, make sure at least one teammate has a way to apply healing reduction.
KSante.phase: Your trades are weak without enough stacks, so look for short trades only when you’re set up for them. In the mid game, Gwen becomes strong in duels as she builds ability power items. In the late game, use Gwen’s max-health damage to attack frontliners like K'Sante directly.

Malphite.watch: If Malphite Q Seismic Shard hits you, its slow makes it hard to engage or disengage, so don’t start a trade right after being hit. Malphite R Unstoppable Force is an unstoppable dash that can knock up multiple enemies, so when you don’t know where he is, don’t group with allies near walls or bushes.
Malphite.build: Build magic resistance first to withstand the damage from Malphite Q Seismic Shard, E Ground Slam, and R Unstoppable Force. Gwen mainly deals magic damage and Gwen P A Thousand Cuts also deals max-health-based damage, so you have little need to stack armor penetration to counter Malphite’s armor.
Malphite.fight: Break Malphite P Granite Shield first, then build stacks of Gwen Q Snip Snip! with basic attacks before trading. Hold off on engaging while slowed by Malphite Q Seismic Shard, and use Gwen E Skip 'n Slash to close the gap when Malphite R Unstoppable Force is down.
Malphite.laning: Early on, secure CS and levels while breaking Malphite P Granite Shield. Poke at short intervals to keep the shield from regenerating. Malphite Q Seismic Shard can’t be blocked by minions, so don’t stay in range for long. Save Gwen W Hallowed Mist to respond to ganks when pushing the lane.
Malphite.combo: Build stacks of Gwen Q Snip Snip! by basic attacking minions or Malphite. After breaking Malphite P Granite Shield, close in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash and land an empowered basic attack, then cast Gwen Q Snip Snip! with Malphite in the center of the cone. If he’s far away, slow him with the first cast of Gwen R Needlework, then approach with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash.
Malphite.escape: Don’t engage immediately after being hit and slowed by Malphite Q Seismic Shard.
Malphite.phase: By mid game, Gwen becomes strong in duels as she builds ability power items. In the late game, her max-health-based damage lets her attack frontline champions like Malphite directly.
Malphite.teamfight: Spread out from allies so Malphite R Unstoppable Force doesn’t knock up multiple people, then counterattack as soon as his ultimate is down. Against frontline Malphite, engage with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash, use Gwen W Hallowed Mist to withstand focused attacks, then hit the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!.

Kennen.watch: Dodge Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken from behind minions. When Kennen P Mark of the Storm has stacked twice, back off to avoid a third mark. When Kennen comes in with R Slicing Maelstrom, create distance so you don’t get caught in the area stun.
Kennen.build: For your first defensive purchase, prioritize magic resistance against Kennen’s magic damage.
Kennen.fight: Build stacks of Gwen Q Snip Snip! by attacking minions, then close in when Kennen E Lightning Rush is down. If Kennen tries to land an empowered basic attack from outside the mist, use Gwen W Hallowed Mist to avoid it, and position him in the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!.
Kennen.laning: Early on, secure CS and levels while using minions to block Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken. After learning Gwen W Hallowed Mist, use it to withstand his poke, but save it for gank defense when pushing the lane.
Kennen.combo: Build stacks of Gwen Q Snip Snip! first with basic attacks on minions. If Kennen is far away, slow him with the first cast of Gwen R Needlework, then close in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash and land an empowered basic attack. Keep Kennen in the center and cast Gwen Q Snip Snip!.
Kennen.escape: Engage with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash when Kennen E Lightning Rush is down and Kennen P Mark of the Storm stacks aren’t dangerous. If two marks have stacked, back off first and engage after they disappear.
Kennen.phase: Since it’s difficult to build stacks, focus on scaling instead of forcing trades. After learning Gwen W Hallowed Mist, you can withstand Kennen’s poke, and your dueling gets stronger from mid game as you build ability power items. In the late game, attack the enemy frontline with your max-health-based damage.
Kennen.teamfight: Spread out from allies to avoid the area stun from Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom, and use vision to track his approach. Engage when key crowd control is down or Gwen W Hallowed Mist is ready, then hit the frontline with the center damage of Gwen Q Snip Snip!.

Kled.build: Build armor first because Kled’s main sources of damage—Q Bear Trap on a Rope, W Violent Tendencies, and E Jousting—deal physical damage.
Kled.fight: Early on, don’t force your way in. Build stacks of Gwen Q Snip Snip! with basic attacks, then trade. Avoid Kled W Violent Tendencies’ fourth basic attack, then re-engage and position Kled in the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip! to deal damage.
Kled.laning: Since it’s difficult to build stacks, focus on CS and levels. When Kled dismounts from Skaarl, watch his courage meter and create distance if you can’t finish him immediately. Dismounted Kled also builds courage by killing minions, so deny him farm before he remounts to protect your advantage.
Kled.combo: Build stacks of Gwen Q Snip Snip! by basic attacking minions, then close in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash and land an empowered basic attack. Follow up with Gwen Q Snip Snip!, keeping Kled in the center of the scissors. If he’s far away, slow him with the first cast of Gwen R Needlework and approach with E, then continue casting R when you can keep him in range.
Kled.escape: Right after Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope catches you, escape with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash before you’re pulled in. Decide when to engage by checking whether Kled has used both E Jousting and R Chaaaaaaaarge!!!; in particular, use Gwen E Skip 'n Slash to close the gap during the window before his R comes back up.
Kled.phase: Early on, Gwen should focus on scaling without giving Kled an advantage. Gwen’s dueling gets stronger in mid game as she builds ability power items, while Kled falls off as he moves past the laning phase and mid game. In the late game, Gwen can fight the frontline directly with her max-health-based damage.
Kled.teamfight: Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! comes from far away, so use side vision to spot his approach early. If you can’t stop him, maintain your formation, since he charges the first enemy champion in his path. Engage with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash when Kled’s key crowd control is down or Gwen W Hallowed Mist is ready, use W to withstand focused attacks, and hit the frontline with the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!.
Kled.watch: If Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope catches you, use Gwen E Skip 'n Slash to create distance before he pulls you in. When Kled W Violent Tendencies is active, back off to avoid taking the fourth basic attack, which deals max-health damage, then re-engage.

Kayle.build: The available information isn’t enough to determine your first purchase. If the healing from Kayle W Celestial Blessing turns duels around, get healing reduction with Morellonomicon. Magic resistance, rather than armor, is the resistance to build against Kayle’s damage, and Kayle Q Radiant Blast reduces its effectiveness, so avoid taking a direct hit.
Kayle.fight: Since it’s difficult to build stacks, avoid forcing trades. Later, build stacks with basic attacks and close in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash when Kayle Q Radiant Blast is down. Activate Gwen W Hallowed Mist so Kayle stays outside the mist, then fight while avoiding her counterattack.
Kayle.laning: Early on, Gwen should focus on CS and levels instead of forcing kills. Before a fight, build stacks of Gwen Q Snip Snip! by attacking minions.
Kayle.combo: Build stacks of Gwen Q Snip Snip! with basic attacks, then approach with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash and land an empowered basic attack. Keep Kayle in the center of the cone and cast Gwen Q Snip Snip! to hit her with true damage. If she’s far away, slow her with the first cast of Gwen R Needlework, then close in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash, but save your follow-up damage while Kayle R Divine Judgment makes her invulnerable.
Kayle.escape: Kayle has no mobility skill, so close the gap with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash after Kayle Q Radiant Blast is used or misses. If the movement speed boost from Kayle W Celestial Blessing is down, it’s a better opportunity to catch her. After Kayle uses R Divine Judgment, time your next attack for when the invulnerability ends.
Kayle.teamfight: Find an approach from the flank or out of vision so Kayle can’t attack freely from the backline, and coordinate your engage timing with allied crowd control. When Kayle R Divine Judgment is active, use the slow from Gwen R Needlework to keep her close, then focus your damage after the invulnerability ends. If it’s hard to reach Kayle, use Gwen W Hallowed Mist to withstand focused attacks while landing the center damage of Gwen Q Snip Snip! on the frontline.
Kayle.watch: Avoid a direct hit from Kayle Q Radiant Blast, which slows and reduces armor and magic resistance. Kayle E Starfire Spellblade deals damage based on your missing health, so watch out for follow-up attacks when your health is low. Don’t unload damage while Kayle R Divine Judgment is active; attack again after the invulnerability ends.

Mordekaiser.watch: If Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp pulls you in, you're likely to be hit by Mordekaiser Q Obliterate afterward, so keep your distance when facing him and dodge the pull. Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise activates after three hits, so trade briefly and back off. When Mordekaiser R Realm of Death is ready, don't enter his range alone, so you can avoid a duel without your team's help.
Mordekaiser.fight: Early on, don't stay in a trade long enough for Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise to activate. Once Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp is down and you've stacked Gwen Q Snip Snip!, close the gap with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash. Don't commit your damage right after Mordekaiser W Indestructible's shield appears; focus him once it wears down or converts into healing.
Mordekaiser.laning: Early on, prioritize CS and levels over risky duels, and stack Gwen Q Snip Snip! by hitting minions. If Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp pulls you in, end the trade quickly before Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise activates. Save Gwen W Hallowed Mist to respond to ganks when pushing the lane.
Mordekaiser.combo: Build stacks of Gwen Q Snip Snip! first by basic attacking minions or Mordekaiser. Once Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp is down, close in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash, land an empowered basic attack, then cast Gwen Q Snip Snip! with Mordekaiser in the center of the cone. If you need to close the gap, slow him with the first cast of Gwen R Needlework before going in.
Mordekaiser.escape: When Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp misses or is on cooldown, look for an opening to go in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash. Mordekaiser has no mobility, so once you're on him, he has trouble creating distance. However, avoid entering his ultimate range alone while Mordekaiser R Realm of Death is ready.
Mordekaiser.phase: Early on, Gwen has trouble stacking Gwen Q Snip Snip!, so focus on farming and avoid extended trades that activate Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise. Gwen becomes strong in duels from mid game as you build ability power items, so look for openings when Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp is down. In late game, use the max-health damage from Gwen P A Thousand Cuts against the frontline.
Mordekaiser.teamfight: Keep your distance from allies so you don't all get pulled in by Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp. Go in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash when the enemy's key crowd control is down or Gwen W Hallowed Mist is ready, then hit the frontline with the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!. If Mordekaiser R Realm of Death traps you, your team can't help, so be wary of positions where you could face Mordekaiser alone.
Mordekaiser.build: Build magic resistance first against Mordekaiser’s main ability damage. Armor also helps against his basic attacks, but don’t stack only health, given the penetration from Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp and Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise deals damage based on your maximum health. If healing from Mordekaiser W Indestructible turns the duel around, get healing reduction with Morellonomicon.

Nasus.build: Build armor first against Nasus's main damage, Nasus Q Siphoning Strike. Consider magic resistance if the magic damage from Nasus E Spirit Fire and Nasus R Fury of the Sands is a problem, but step out of Nasus E Spirit Fire's area first.
Nasus.fight: Stack Gwen Q Snip Snip! by basic attacking minions, then trade when Nasus is about to last-hit. Close in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash, land an empowered basic attack, then deal true damage with Gwen Q Snip Snip! with Nasus in the center. Stop fighting when Nasus R Fury of the Sands activates unless you have a clear advantage.
Nasus.laning: Don't force a trade when you lack stacks, since your damage will be low. Instead of pushing the lane under Nasus's turret and letting him last-hit safely, let him come toward you and look for a jungle gank.
Nasus.combo: Build Gwen Q Snip Snip! stacks with basic attacks. Against a Nasus at range, slow him with the first cast of Gwen R Needlework, then close in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash. Land an empowered basic attack, then cast Gwen Q Snip Snip! with Nasus in the center of the cone. Follow up with Gwen R Needlework while Nasus remains in range.
Nasus.escape: When Nasus W Wither is down, look for an opening to go in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash. Nasus has no ability to create distance himself, so if Nasus R Fury of the Sands is not active and you're ready to fight, get on him and apply pressure. Don't move around alone within his range while Nasus W Wither is ready.
Nasus.phase: Build stacks before fighting. Gwen becomes strong in duels in mid game, so look for an opening while Nasus R Fury of the Sands is down. Nasus becomes more dangerous over time because of his Nasus Q Siphoning Strike stacks, so don't let him stack safely into late game.
Nasus.teamfight: If Nasus R Fury of the Sands activates, don't meet him head-on. Keep your distance and let its duration run out. Go in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash when the enemy's key crowd control is down or Gwen W Hallowed Mist is ready, and hit the frontline with the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!. Gwen W Hallowed Mist increases your armor and magic resistance while you're under focused attack.
Nasus.watch: Nasus W Wither reduces movement and attack speed, making it harder for Gwen to auto-attack and chase, so don’t force your way in while it’s active. When Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active, his health and defensive stats increase, so avoid fighting unless you have a clear advantage and let its duration run out.

Olaf.watch: Being hit by Olaf Q Undertow reduces your armor and slows you, so dodge the axe as it flies and move to the opposite side of where it lands. Olaf E Reckless Swing deals true damage, so it's dangerous to rely only on the armor from Gwen W Hallowed Mist when your health is low. While Olaf R Ragnarok is active, create distance instead of relying on the slow from Gwen R Needlework.
Olaf.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Olaf Q Undertow. However, Olaf Q Undertow reduces your armor, and resistance can't reduce Olaf E Reckless Swing's damage, so also get health. Since Olaf's basic attacks and attack speed are central to his damage, reducing his attack speed is also effective.
Olaf.fight: Build Gwen Q Snip Snip! stacks with basic attacks, then trade briefly. When Olaf starts a basic attack or targeted attack from outside the mist, activate Gwen W Hallowed Mist to evade the counterattack, and keep Olaf in the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!. Olaf becomes more dangerous at low health, so don't stay in an extended fight just because he's at half health.
Olaf.laning: Early on, don't force an engage; focus on CS and levels. Move opposite to where Olaf Q Undertow lands to make it harder for him to retrieve the axe and re-engage. Save Gwen W Hallowed Mist to respond to ganks when pushing the lane.
Olaf.combo: Build Gwen Q Snip Snip! stacks first by basic attacking minions or Olaf. If Olaf R Ragnarok is not active, slow him with the first cast of Gwen R Needlework, then close in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash and land an empowered basic attack. Cast Gwen Q Snip Snip! with Olaf in the center. Follow up with the remaining casts of Gwen R Needlework while Olaf remains in range.
Olaf.escape: Dodge Olaf Q Undertow and move to the opposite side of where the axe lands. Go in when it's difficult for Olaf to retrieve it immediately. If Olaf R Ragnarok is active, create distance and let its duration run out before engaging. Olaf has no ability to create distance himself, so close the gap with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash when you have an opening.
Olaf.phase: Gwen becomes strong in duels from mid game as you build ability power items. Olaf becomes relatively weaker in late game, while Gwen can use max-health damage against the frontline.
Olaf.teamfight: Attack the frontline and hit the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!. When you go in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash, Gwen W Hallowed Mist can help you evade focused attacks from enemies outside the mist if it's ready. While Olaf R Ragnarok is active, don't try to stick to him with the slow from Gwen R Needlework; create distance and fight again afterward.

Ornn.watch: Stay away from walls and the pillar left by Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture. Ornn E Searing Charge can knock you up nearby, so move toward open ground when you see him prepare to charge. If Ornn W Bellows Breath makes you brittle with its final burst, keep your distance until the effect ends.
Ornn.fight: Build Gwen Q Snip Snip! stacks with basic attacks, then close in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash when Ornn's mobility and crowd control are down. Keep Ornn in the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip! to deal true damage, and use Gwen W Hallowed Mist to increase your armor and magic resistance when he retaliates.
Ornn.laning: Early on, focus on CS and levels and build Gwen Q Snip Snip! stacks by hitting minions instead of forcing an engage. If Ornn tries to craft an item in lane, approach and attack him to interrupt it. Save Gwen W Hallowed Mist for ganks when pushing the lane.
Ornn.combo: Build Gwen Q Snip Snip! stacks first by basic attacking minions or Ornn. If Ornn backs away, slow him with the first cast of Gwen R Needlework, then close in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash and land an empowered basic attack. Cast Gwen Q Snip Snip! with Ornn in the center of the cone, then follow up with Gwen R Needlework when you can keep him in range.
Ornn.escape: Don't go in just because Ornn E Searing Charge is down; wait until Ornn R Call of the Forge God is also unavailable. If Ornn W Bellows Breath makes you brittle, close the gap with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash after the effect ends. Avoid walls and the pillar from Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture when engaging.
Ornn.phase: It's hard to build stacks, so your trade damage is low; focus on growing first. While Ornn's early damage is low, disrupt his crafting and look for chances to get ahead. Gwen becomes strong in duels from mid game as you build ability power items, and in late game, attack frontliners like Ornn directly with max-health damage.
Ornn.teamfight: Move out of the line between the spirit from Ornn R Call of the Forge God and Ornn, and position yourself to dodge the recast attack as well. Go in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash when Ornn's key crowd control is down or Gwen W Hallowed Mist is ready. Use Gwen W Hallowed Mist to increase your resistances and deal true damage to frontliners like Ornn with the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!.

Poppy.fight: Build stacks for Gwen Q Snip Snip! with basic attacks, then fight once you've confirmed that Poppy W Steadfast Presence has ended. If Poppy E Heroic Charge is on cooldown, close the gap with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash. Keep Poppy in the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip! to deal true damage and apply Gwen P A Thousand Cuts. Even as Poppy’s health decreases, her armor increases, so don’t chase recklessly without calculating your finishing damage.
Poppy.laning: Early on, don’t force an approach. Focus on CS and levels while building stacks for Gwen Q Snip Snip! with basic attacks on minions. Don’t stand with your back to a wall, so you can avoid the stun from Poppy E Heroic Charge. When Poppy P Iron Ambassador’s buckler drops, step on it first to deny her shield. Save Gwen W Hallowed Mist for gank protection when pushing the lane.
Poppy.combo: Build stacks for Gwen Q Snip Snip! first by basic attacking minions or Poppy. Once Poppy W Steadfast Presence ends, if needed, slow her with the first cast of Gwen R Needlework, then close in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash and land an empowered basic attack. Keep Poppy in the center when using Gwen Q Snip Snip!. Continue casting Gwen R Needlework while Poppy remains in range.
Poppy.phase: Gwen’s dueling gets stronger from mid game as you build ability power items. In late game, Gwen can attack frontliners like Poppy directly with the max-health-based damage from Gwen P A Thousand Cuts and Gwen R Needlework.
Poppy.teamfight: As Gwen, attack the frontline Poppy, but don’t engage with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash while Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active. Engage when Poppy’s key crowd control is on cooldown or Gwen W Hallowed Mist is ready to reduce incoming focus, and hit the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!. Use the slow from Gwen R Needlework to keep your target in range, and check that the enemy is still in range before recasting it.
Poppy.build: Build armor first against the main damage from Poppy Q Hammer Shock, Poppy E Heroic Charge, and Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict. Don’t spend resources on magic resistance just to face Poppy, and avoid stacking only health since Poppy Q Hammer Shock deals damage based on your maximum health.
Poppy.watch: If you dash in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash while Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, your dash is blocked and you briefly can’t use movement abilities. Stay in open space so Poppy E Heroic Charge can’t stun you against a wall. If you’re hit by the first strike of Poppy Q Hammer Shock, walk out of the area before the second explosion. Move sideways out of the way when Poppy charges R Keeper’s Verdict.

Pantheon.watch: Pantheon W Shield Vault stuns a targeted enemy, so take care not to give him an opening to get in range. When Pantheon uses Pantheon Q Comet Spear for a long-range poke, standing behind minions can reduce its damage. Pantheon E Aegis Assault blocks damage from the front, so wait for it to end or move to the side.
Pantheon.build: Build armor first to prepare for Pantheon’s main ability damage. Pantheon W Shield Vault deals damage based on your max health, so avoid stacking only health. Then build ability power items to improve your mid-game dueling.
Pantheon.fight: Pantheon is strong early, so don’t start by exchanging blows with him head-on. Build stacks for Gwen Q Snip Snip! with basic attacks, then close in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash after Pantheon W Shield Vault is on cooldown. When Pantheon E Aegis Assault is active, don’t unload damage from the front; move to the side or wait for it to end.
Pantheon.laning: Stand behind minions against Pantheon Q Comet Spear poke, and build stacks for Gwen Q Snip Snip! by basic attacking minions before trading. Save Gwen W Hallowed Mist for gank protection when pushing the lane.
Pantheon.combo: Build stacks for Gwen Q Snip Snip! first by basic attacking minions or Pantheon. When Pantheon W Shield Vault is on cooldown, close in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash and land an empowered basic attack. Keep Pantheon in the center of the cone when using Gwen Q Snip Snip!. If Pantheon E Aegis Assault is blocking damage from the front, reposition or wait for it to end before dealing damage.
Pantheon.escape: The opportunity to engage comes when Pantheon W Shield Vault is on cooldown and before Pantheon R Grand Starfall is ready again. Close the gap with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash then, but be cautious about engaging where there are no targets to hit and you'll have to wait a long time before you can use Gwen E Skip 'n Slash again.
Pantheon.phase: Gwen’s dueling gets stronger from mid game as you build ability power items. Pantheon’s influence falls off in late game, while Gwen can deal with frontliners using max-health-based damage.
Pantheon.teamfight: Engage when a key crowd-control ability like Pantheon W Shield Vault is on cooldown or Gwen W Hallowed Mist is ready. Use Gwen E Skip 'n Slash to reach the frontline, Gwen W Hallowed Mist to handle incoming focus, and hit the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!. If you see the landing indicator for Pantheon R Grand Starfall, walk out of its landing area.

Renekton.watch: If Renekton P Reign of Anger is above half or just below it, stay out of range to avoid the stun from an empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator. Renekton E Slice and Dice unlocks a second dash when it hits a unit, so don’t stand in or behind a minion wave.
Renekton.laning: Early on, avoid forcing trades and focus on CS and levels while building stacks for Gwen Q Snip Snip! on minions. Even if Renekton steps forward to build fury, don’t stand in or behind the minion wave and give him a launch point for Renekton E Slice and Dice. Save Gwen W Hallowed Mist to respond to ganks when pushing the lane.
Renekton.combo: Build stacks for Gwen Q Snip Snip! with basic attacks, then close in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash and land an empowered basic attack while Renekton E Slice and Dice is on cooldown. Keep Renekton in the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip! to deal true damage and apply Gwen P A Thousand Cuts. If you need to approach from far away, slow him with the first cast of Gwen R Needlework, then close in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash.
Renekton.escape: Engage with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash after Renekton E Slice and Dice is on cooldown and the stun from Renekton W Ruthless Predator has been used. The moment after Renekton uses Renekton E Slice and Dice to disengage is especially good for closing the gap. On the other hand, delay your engage if Renekton has enough fury to empower an ability or Renekton R Dominus is active.
Renekton.phase: Since it’s hard to build stacks, focus on scaling. Gwen’s dueling gets stronger from mid game, while Renekton’s value falls off, so grow without giving up kills. In late game, use the max-health-based damage from Gwen P A Thousand Cuts and Gwen R Needlework to deal with the frontline.
Renekton.teamfight: Engage when a key crowd-control ability like Renekton W Ruthless Predator is on cooldown or Gwen W Hallowed Mist is ready. Use Gwen E Skip 'n Slash to reach the frontline, Gwen W Hallowed Mist to avoid focus from outside the mist, and hit the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!. Use the slow from the first cast of Gwen R Needlework to keep your opponent in range, and recast it while they remain in range.
Renekton.build: Build armor first because the main damage from Renekton Q Cull the Meek, Renekton W Ruthless Predator, and Renekton E Slice and Dice is physical. The empowered recast of Renekton E Slice and Dice reduces your armor, so position to avoid that dash. If healing from Renekton Q Cull the Meek turns the duel around, get healing reduction with Morellonomicon.
Renekton.fight: Trade when Renekton P Reign of Anger’s bar is empty. After Renekton uses Q Cull the Meek, W Ruthless Predator, and E Slice and Dice, close the gap with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash and retaliate. Use Gwen W Hallowed Mist when Renekton tries to target you with an attack from outside the mist to negate it.

Riven.watch: Riven Q Broken Wings knocks you airborne at the end of its chained dashes, and Riven W Ki Burst stuns you.
Riven.build: All of Riven’s damage is physical, so build armor first. If Riven gets ahead, buy defensive items earlier, and don’t stay within range of Riven R Blade of the Exile when your health is low.
Riven.fight: Build stacks for Gwen Q Snip Snip! by basic attacking minions before fighting. When Riven uses Riven Q Broken Wings to clear minions, close in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash and land an empowered basic attack. Keep her in the center when using Gwen Q Snip Snip!.
Riven.laning: Early on, focus on CS and levels instead of forcing trades. Look to retaliate when Riven uses Riven Q Broken Wings on the wave, but save Gwen W Hallowed Mist to respond to ganks when pushing the lane.
Riven.combo: Build stacks for Gwen Q Snip Snip! with basic attacks, close in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash and land an empowered basic attack, then hit Gwen Q Snip Snip! with its center. If the distance is too great, slow your opponent with the first cast of Gwen R Needlework before approaching, and recast it when you can keep them in range.
Riven.escape: An opportunity to engage comes just after Riven uses Riven Q Broken Wings on minions or has used all its chained dashes. If Riven E Valor is still available, she can escape, so confirm that both movement abilities have been used before closing the gap with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash.
Riven.phase: Since it’s hard to build stacks, your trades are weak, so focus on scaling. Your dueling gets stronger from mid game as you build ability power items, and in late game you can fight the frontline directly with max-health-based damage.
Riven.teamfight: Watch out for the knock-up from Riven Q Broken Wings and the stun from Riven W Ki Burst. Engage when her key crowd control is down or Gwen W Hallowed Mist is ready. Use Gwen E Skip 'n Slash to reach the frontline, take advantage of the armor increase from Gwen W Hallowed Mist, and hit your target with the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!.

Quinn.watch: When Quinn P Harrier marks you, step out of her basic attack range to avoid the empowered basic attack. Dodge Quinn Q Blinding Assault from behind your minion wave, and don’t force an approach while Quinn E Vault is available. When Quinn is about to land a marked basic attack, use Gwen W Hallowed Mist to block attacks from outside the mist.
Quinn.build: Get armor first. Quinn’s main damage is physical, so armor is more effective than magic resistance.
Quinn.fight: Start trading after Quinn E Vault is down. Build Gwen Q Snip Snip! stacks with basic attacks beforehand, then close the gap with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash and land an empowered basic attack and the center hit of Q. Evade Quinn’s retaliatory basic attacks with Gwen W Hallowed Mist.
Quinn.laning: Early on, don’t force fights within Quinn’s range; preserve your health and CS. Farm when Quinn P Harrier is not marking you, and step out of attack range when it does. Save Gwen W Hallowed Mist while pushing the lane so you can respond to ganks.
Quinn.combo: Build Gwen Q Snip Snip! stacks first by basic attacking minions. Once Quinn E Vault is down, close in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash, land an empowered basic attack, and use Q with Quinn in the center. If Gwen R Needlework is available, close the gap with the slow from its first cast, then continue casting it.
Quinn.escape: The moment Quinn E Vault is down is your chance to engage. Until then, don’t use Gwen E Skip 'n Slash to engage; wait until Quinn uses her escape, then close the gap with E.
Quinn.phase: Early on, Quinn pressures you with her range, so prioritize your health and growth. In late game, Gwen fights the frontline with percent max-health damage and joins teamfights.
Quinn.teamfight: Gwen should attack the frontline instead of looking for Quinn and diving in from the side. Engage with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash to land the center hit of Q when the enemy’s key crowd control is down or Gwen W Hallowed Mist is ready. If Quinn dives in from the side, respond with your team’s crowd control.

Rumble.watch: Watch out for the first cast of Rumble E Electro Harpoon. Getting hit by both casts in a row causes a stronger slow and reduces your magic resistance, so if the first hits you, use Gwen E Skip 'n Slash to create distance before the second. Don’t stay within Rumble Q Flamespitter range for long.
Rumble.build: If you need a defensive item, choose one with magic resistance first. Rumble P Junkyard Titan and Rumble Q Flamespitter deal damage based on your max health, so avoid relying only on health. Gwen’s dueling gets stronger from midgame as you build ability power items.
Rumble.fight: Build Gwen Q Snip Snip! stacks with basic attacks before fighting. If Rumble W Scrap Shield is active, wait briefly for the shield to end, dodge Rumble E Electro Harpoon, then close in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash. Use Gwen Q Snip Snip! with Rumble in the center of the cone.
Rumble.laning: Prepare Gwen Q Snip Snip! stacks by attacking minions, and position so the trade starts only when Rumble walks forward. Keep Gwen W Hallowed Mist available for ganks while pushing the lane.
Rumble.escape: If the first cast of Rumble E Electro Harpoon hits you, use Gwen E Skip 'n Slash to get away before the second harpoon. When engaging, dodge Rumble E Electro Harpoon and wait out the shield from Rumble W Scrap Shield. Rumble has no mobility, so close the gap with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash then.
Rumble.phase: Don’t rush trades with Rumble, since it’s hard to build stacks. After learning Gwen W Hallowed Mist, you can endure his poke, and your dueling gets stronger from midgame as you build ability power items. Later, fight the frontline directly with percent max health damage.
Rumble.teamfight: Attack the frontline first and hit the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!. Engage with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash when the enemy’s key crowd control is down or Gwen W Hallowed Mist is ready. Use Gwen W Hallowed Mist to increase your armor and magic resistance while you’re under focused attack, and continue casting Gwen R Needlework while the enemy remains in range.
Rumble.combo: Fully stack Gwen Q Snip Snip! first by auto-attacking minions or Rumble. If Rumble is retreating at range, slow him with the first cast of Gwen R Needlework, then close in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash and land an empowered auto-attack. Keep Rumble in the center when using Gwen Q Snip Snip!, and continue casting Gwen R Needlework while he remains in range.

Sett.watch: Sett W Haymaker gets stronger right after he takes a lot of damage, so briefly create distance after dealing damage and avoid the center of its aim. Sett E Facebreaker stuns if enemies are on both sides, so don’t stand across Sett from an ally or minion. Sett R The Show Stopper suppresses you if it catches you, so position carefully in front of Sett when his ultimate is ready.
Sett.build: Buy armor first to counter Sett’s main damage. Resistance can’t reduce the true damage at the center of Sett W Haymaker, so dodge it by repositioning. Sett Q Knuckle Down deals damage based on your max health, so think carefully before stacking health alone.
Sett.fight: Build Gwen Q Snip Snip! stacks with basic attacks, then close in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash and land an empowered attack and the center damage of Q. If Sett W Haymaker is about to hit hard, briefly retreat and fight again after his Grit fades.
Sett.combo: Build Gwen Q Snip Snip! stacks with basic attacks. If the distance is long, slow Sett with the first cast of Gwen R Needlework, close in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash and land an empowered attack, then use Q with Sett in the center. If you’ve dealt enough damage to make Sett W Haymaker strong, create distance and engage again after his Grit fades.
Sett.escape: It’s a good time to engage when Sett E Facebreaker is down, since you don’t have to worry about its stun. After engaging, if Sett W Haymaker gets stronger, retreat while avoiding the center of its aim.
Sett.phase: Focus on scaling, since it’s hard to build stacks. Gwen’s dueling gets stronger from midgame as you build ability power items, and later you can fight the frontline with percent max health damage.
Sett.teamfight: Gwen should attack the frontline and hit the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!. Engage with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash when the enemy’s key crowd control is down or Gwen W Hallowed Mist is ready. Watch your position so Sett R The Show Stopper doesn’t catch you and you don’t get hit by the center of Sett W Haymaker.

Shen.watch: If Shen E Shadow Dash taunts you, you’re likely to be hit by Shen Q Twilight Assault’s empowered attacks, so dodge its path. Also move out of the path of Shen Q Twilight Assault’s returning spirit blade. When Shen W Spirit's Refuge is active, delay Gwen E Skip 'n Slash’s empowered attack and deal damage with abilities for a moment.
Shen.build: Consider tenacity first because being held by Shen E Shadow Dash’s taunt is dangerous. Shen E Shadow Dash deals physical damage, while Shen Q Twilight Assault deals magic damage, so don’t stack resistance on only one side. Avoid relying only on health, given the percent max health damage on Shen Q Twilight Assault.
Shen.fight: Build Gwen Q Snip Snip! stacks by attacking minions before fighting. If Shen E Shadow Dash misses, close the gap with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash and keep Shen in the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!. Basic attacks are nullified during Shen W Spirit's Refuge, so deal damage with Gwen Q Snip Snip! and follow up with an empowered attack after the field ends.
Shen.laning: Early on, secure CS and levels instead of forcing kills, while preparing Gwen Q Snip Snip! stacks. If you gain lane priority and keep Shen occupied with CS, he loses more when he uses Shen R Stand United to affect another lane. Keep Gwen W Hallowed Mist available for ganks while pushing the lane.
Shen.combo: Build Gwen Q Snip Snip! stacks by attacking minions. If Shen is far away, slow him with the first cast of Gwen R Needlework, then close in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash. Land an empowered attack when Shen W Spirit's Refuge is down, and use Gwen Q Snip Snip! with Shen in the center.
Shen.escape: The moment Shen E Shadow Dash misses is your chance to engage with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash. Don’t rush in while Shen E Shadow Dash is available, since you can be caught by its taunt. Once Shen R Stand United is down, look for an opening when he can’t escape with that mobility.
Shen.phase: From midgame, Gwen’s dueling gets strong as you build ability power items, so take control when Shen E Shadow Dash is down. Later, fight Shen and other frontline champions directly with Gwen’s percent max health damage.
Shen.teamfight: Keep in mind that Shen may join the fight with Shen R Stand United, and alert your team immediately if he leaves lane or starts channeling. In teamfights, engage when Shen E Shadow Dash is down or Gwen W Hallowed Mist is ready. Hit the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip! on the frontline, including Shen, then continue casting Gwen R Needlework.

Skarner.watch: Skarner E Ixtal's Impact stuns Gwen if he slams her into a wall, so don’t stand with your back to one. After Skarner R Impale suppresses Gwen, she can’t escape with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash, so keep your distance when Skarner approaches.
Skarner.fight: Build stacks of Gwen Q Snip Snip! with basic attacks, then use Gwen E Skip 'n Slash to close in once Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down. Keep Skarner in the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!, and use the armor and magic resistance bonus from Gwen W Hallowed Mist when he retaliates.
Skarner.laning: Build stacks of Gwen Q Snip Snip! by attacking minions, and save Gwen W Hallowed Mist while pushing the lane to protect against ganks.
Skarner.combo: Build stacks of Gwen Q Snip Snip! with basic attacks. If there’s distance between you, slow Skarner with the first cast of Gwen R Needlework, then close in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash and land an empowered basic attack. Keep Skarner centered when you cast Gwen Q Snip Snip!. If he remains in range, continue with Gwen R Needlework.
Skarner.phase: Trades are weak because it’s hard to build stacks, so focus on scaling. Gwen becomes strong in duels from mid game as her ability power items come together, and in the late game she can directly attack frontliners like Skarner with percentage max health damage. Skarner’s damage also increases as he builds tank items, so take early jungle control and objectives to delay that timing.
Skarner.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Skarner P Threads of Vibration, Skarner W Seismic Bastion, and Skarner R Impale. If you need a way to break Skarner R Impale’s suppression, decide ahead of time whether to include Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar in your build.
