Skarner.escape: The moment after you force Skarner to use E Ixtal's Impact is your chance to close the gap with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash. Don’t engage with your back to a wall, and be mindful of where you enter the short range of Skarner R Impale.

Singed.watch: Don’t chase Singed when his health is low while walking through Singed Q Poison Trail. Gwen E Skip 'n Slash can’t be used on Singed W Mega Adhesive, and if Singed E Fling hits you there, you will also be rooted, so go around the adhesive. If Singed is standing with allies behind him, keep enough distance that Singed E Fling can’t throw you into that formation.
Singed.build: Get movement speed first so you can get out of the poison trail, and build magic resistance against Singed’s magic damage. Singed E Fling deals percentage max health damage, so don’t rely on simply stacking health.
Singed.fight: Build stacks of Gwen Q Snip Snip! with basic attacks, then use Gwen E Skip 'n Slash to close in along a path clear of the adhesive. Keep Singed in the center of Q as you attack, but don’t chase for long while Singed R Insanity Potion is active; account for the healing reduction applied by his poison.
Singed.laning: Save Gwen W Hallowed Mist while pushing the lane to protect against ganks.
Singed.combo: Build stacks of Gwen Q Snip Snip! first with basic attacks, including attacks on minions. Use Gwen E Skip 'n Slash to close in along a path clear of Singed W Mega Adhesive, land an empowered basic attack, then keep Singed in the center when you cast Q. If Singed runs, see if the first cast of Gwen R Needlework can slow him enough to catch him, then continue with it.
Singed.escape: If you dodged Singed W Mega Adhesive and Singed has used Singed E Fling, close the gap with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash and fight. You can’t use E on the adhesive, so don’t plan to enter it or escape from it with E.
Singed.phase: Gwen becomes strong in duels in mid game as her ability power items come together, but Singed is hard to catch once he has his core items, so don’t chase through the poison. In the late game, use Gwen’s percentage max health damage to attack the frontline in front of you.
Singed.teamfight: Slow Singed with Gwen R Needlework to limit his movement, and don’t lose track of his allies by chasing him too far. Engage when Gwen W Hallowed Mist is ready or the enemy’s key crowd control is down, and hit the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip! on the frontline.

Sion.watch: Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught also charges in a straight line, so dodge to the side instead of running forward or backward. After taking Sion down, reposition to avoid the fast attacks and percentage max health damage from Sion P Glory in Death.
Sion.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Sion P Glory in Death, Sion Q Decimating Smash, and Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught. Armor can’t block the magic damage from Sion W Soul Furnace or Sion E Roar of the Slayer, and Sion E Roar of the Slayer also reduces armor, so move to avoid it. Sion P Glory in Death deals damage based on your max health, so be careful about heavily stacking health.
Sion.fight: Build stacks of Gwen Q Snip Snip! with basic attacks, then dodge Sion Q Decimating Smash to the side and close in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash to fight. When Sion W Soul Furnace is active, focus your damage on breaking the shield before it explodes, and hit Sion with the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!.
Sion.laning: Sion’s max health permanently increases when he kills units, so when you can fight him, push the lane to disrupt his farming or make plays in other lanes. Save Gwen W Hallowed Mist while pushing the lane to protect against ganks.
Sion.combo: Build stacks of Gwen Q Snip Snip! with basic attacks, and, if needed, slow Sion with the first cast of Gwen R Needlework before closing in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash. Land an empowered basic attack, then keep Sion in the center of the cone when you cast Gwen Q Snip Snip!. Continue with Gwen R Needlework while Sion remains in range.
Sion.escape: Dodging the knockup and stun from Sion Q Decimating Smash to the side also creates an opportunity to engage.
Sion.phase: Gwen becomes strong in duels from mid game as her ability power items come together, and in the late game she can directly attack frontliners like Sion with percentage max health damage. Sion’s max health also increases as he kills units, so don’t let him keep farming freely.
Sion.teamfight: Engage on Sion, the frontline, after dodging Sion Q Decimating Smash and Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught, or when Gwen W Hallowed Mist is ready. Close in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash, use Gwen W Hallowed Mist against focused attacks, and hit the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!. When Sion goes down, keep your distance and reposition until Sion P Glory in Death ends.

Teemo.build: Build magic resistance first because Teemo Q Blinding Dart, Teemo E Toxic Shot, and Teemo R Noxious Trap deal his main damage as magic damage. Then keep up Gwen’s scaling, which becomes strong from mid game as her ability power items come together.
Teemo.fight: Don’t force an approach early. Build stacks of Gwen Q Snip Snip! by attacking minions, then prepare to trade. Once Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down, close the gap with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash and use Gwen W Hallowed Mist to avoid Teemo’s retaliation. Once you’re close, land an empowered basic attack and keep Teemo in the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!.
Teemo.laning: After learning Gwen W Hallowed Mist, look to trade while using it to avoid Teemo’s ranged harass. Save Gwen W Hallowed Mist while pushing the lane so you can respond to ganks, and don’t pass by brush where you have no vision.
Teemo.combo: Build stacks of Gwen Q Snip Snip! first by basic attacking minions. After Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down, close in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash, land an empowered basic attack, then keep Teemo centered when you cast Gwen Q Snip Snip!. If there’s too much distance, slow him with the first cast of Gwen R Needlework before engaging.
Teemo.escape: The moment Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down is your chance to engage with basic attacks mixed in. If Teemo has also used Teemo W Move Quick, close the gap with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash and continue the trade using the increased attack range.
Teemo.phase: It’s hard to build stacks of Gwen Q Snip Snip! early, so avoid Teemo’s harass and focus on scaling. Gwen becomes strong in duels from mid game as her ability power items come together, and her main magic damage is effective against Teemo, who tends to have low magic resistance. In the late game, use the percentage max health damage from Gwen P A Thousand Cuts against the frontline.
Teemo.teamfight: Use Oracle Lens to clear Teemo R Noxious Trap around objectives and in narrow passages as you move. Gwen should engage with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash when Gwen W Hallowed Mist is ready or the enemy’s key crowd control is down. Use Gwen W Hallowed Mist to avoid focused attacks, and hit the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip! on the frontline.
Teemo.watch: Teemo Q Blinding Dart negates basic attacks, so if you’re hit, stop auto-attacking and deal damage with Gwen Q Snip Snip! or retreat. Even one basic attack from Teemo E Toxic Shot applies ongoing poison damage, so stay out of range if you aren’t ready to commit. Watch for Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare’s stealth and Teemo R Noxious Trap in bushes without vision and along paths leading to objectives.

TahmKench.watch: If Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste has stacked twice from an attack and Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash, back off and wait for the stacks to expire. When you see the animation for Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive, create distance to avoid the knock-up at its landing point.
TahmKench.build: Build magic resistance first against Tahm Kench’s main damage sources: Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste, Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash, and Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive. If the healing from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and Tahm Kench E Thick Skin can turn a duel, get healing reduction from Morellonomicon.
TahmKench.fight: Build Gwen Q Snip Snip! stacks with attacks, then close in and unload your damage at once. When Tahm Kench tries to retaliate with attacks, cast Gwen W Hallowed Mist to block attacks coming from outside the mist, then keep fighting with the increased resistances. Tahm Kench’s gray health can turn into a shield or healing, so avoid short trades where you deal a little damage and back off.
TahmKench.laning: Early on, focus on CS and levels instead of forcing fights, and prepare Gwen Q Snip Snip! stacks by attacking minions. If Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste has two stacks, back out of his range. When pushing the lane, save Gwen W Hallowed Mist to respond to ganks.
TahmKench.combo: Build Gwen Q Snip Snip! stacks with attacks, then use Gwen E Skip 'n Slash to close in and land an empowered attack. Keep Tahm Kench in the center of the cone when you cast Gwen Q Snip Snip! to deal true damage and apply Gwen P A Thousand Cuts. If there is a gap between you, hit with the slow from the first cast of Gwen R Needlework, then approach with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash. Use the follow-up needles while he remains in range.
TahmKench.escape: Once Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive is down, he has a harder time engaging or escaping, so close the gap with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash. If Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste has two stacks, back off first and engage after they expire.
TahmKench.phase: Since it is hard to build stacks, your trades are weak, so focus on scaling. Your dueling gets stronger from mid game as you build ability power items. In late game, use the percent max health damage from Gwen P A Thousand Cuts and Gwen R Needlework against the frontline.
TahmKench.teamfight: Spread out so multiple teammates are not hit by the knock-up from Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive, and engage when key crowd control is down or Gwen W Hallowed Mist is ready. Hit the frontline with the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!, but if Tahm Kench R Devour is available, account for the possibility that he may swallow an enemy he is protecting. If an enemy is swallowed, keep up the pressure with area attacks such as Gwen R Needlework.

Trundle.watch: Trundle gains attack speed and healing while on Trundle W Frozen Domain, so do not fight him there; back away and wait out its duration. Trundle E Pillar of Ice blocks your escape and slows you, so avoid narrow paths and immediately sidestep when the pillar appears. While Trundle R Subjugate is active, it steals resistances and makes Trundle tankier, so create distance.
Trundle.build: Build armor first against Trundle Q Chomp and his basic attacks. Trundle R Subjugate steals resistances and deals damage based on max health, so prioritize getting out of its range over stacking more resistances or health. If Trundle’s healing can turn a duel, get healing reduction from Morellonomicon.
Trundle.fight: Build Gwen Q Snip Snip! stacks with attacks, then take short trades and place Trundle in the center of Q to deal true damage. When Trundle W Frozen Domain is placed, retreat out of it and then re-engage; do not keep dueling while Trundle R Subjugate is active. When retaliating, use Gwen W Hallowed Mist to block targeted attacks coming from outside the mist.
Trundle.laning: Early on, focus on CS and levels instead of forcing fights, and attack minions before trading to prepare Gwen Q Snip Snip! stacks. Trundle heals whenever nearby units die thanks to Trundle P King's Tribute, so do not drag out the lane by only chipping away at his health; secure an advantage or push the lane to force him to recall. When pushing the lane, save Gwen W Hallowed Mist to prepare for ganks.
Trundle.combo: Build Gwen Q Snip Snip! stacks first by attacking a minion or Trundle. If he is far away, slow him with the first cast of Gwen R Needlework, then close in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash and land an empowered attack before casting Gwen Q Snip Snip! with Trundle in the center. Follow up with Gwen R Needlework when you can keep him in range.
Trundle.escape: The window to engage opens after Trundle E Pillar of Ice is down. Trundle has no skill that creates distance, so wait out the strong duration of Trundle W Frozen Domain, then close the gap with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash. If Trundle R Subjugate is active, delay your engage and create distance.
Trundle.phase: Early on, prioritize scaling because Trundle’s basic attacks are strong and Gwen has a hard time building Q stacks.
Trundle.teamfight: Gwen deals true damage from the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip! and percent max health damage to the frontline. Engage with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash when Trundle E Pillar of Ice is down or Gwen W Hallowed Mist is ready, and use W to block focused attacks from outside the mist. If a target is affected by Trundle R Subjugate, attack someone else or create distance while it lasts.

Tryndamere.build: Build armor first since Tryndamere’s main damage is physical. Thornmail is effective against an opponent who relies on attacks. If Tryndamere Q Bloodlust’s healing can turn a duel, get healing reduction from Morellonomicon.
Tryndamere.fight: Build Gwen Q Snip Snip! stacks with attacks before fighting. Once Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is down, close in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash and keep him in the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!. When Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, stop dealing damage and create distance to wait it out.
Tryndamere.laning: Early on, focus on CS and levels instead of forcing duels, while harassing Tryndamere to keep him from building Fury with last hits. If you see him building Fury, create distance before approaching. When pushing the lane, save Gwen W Hallowed Mist to respond to ganks.
Tryndamere.combo: Build Gwen Q Snip Snip! stacks first by attacking a minion or your opponent. Once Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is down, close in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash and land an empowered attack, then cast Gwen Q Snip Snip! with him in the center. If there is a gap between you, slow him with the first cast of Gwen R Needlework before engaging, and save your follow-up damage while Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active.
Tryndamere.escape: Right after Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is down is your chance to engage with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash. However, in areas with many minions, Tryndamere’s critical strikes can make Tryndamere E Spinning Slash come back quickly, so be careful when chasing. If Tryndamere W Mocking Shout hits you, do not immediately start trading attacks.
Tryndamere.phase: Since it is hard to build stacks, your trades are weak, so watch Tryndamere’s Fury and focus on scaling early. Gwen’s dueling gets stronger from mid game as you build ability power items. In late game, use the percent max health damage from Gwen P A Thousand Cuts against the frontline.
Tryndamere.teamfight: Gwen hits the frontline with the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip! and uses Gwen W Hallowed Mist to absorb the enemy’s focused attacks. When Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, do not focus your damage on him; create distance and wait out its duration. Do not try to hold a side lane alone against Tryndamere while Tryndamere R Undying Rage is ready; trade for an objective or send more teammates.
Tryndamere.watch: Tryndamere P Battle Fury builds Fury, making his critical strikes threatening, and Tryndamere Q Bloodlust lets him heal. When he starts building Fury by hitting minions, create some distance. When backing away to dodge Tryndamere W Mocking Shout, walk backward while facing him, and avoid trading basic attacks right after it hits you.

Udyr.watch: Udyr E Blazing Stampede grants movement speed to close in and stuns with his first attack. Udyr Q Wilding Claw’s empowered basic attacks and Udyr R Wingborne Storm deal damage based on max health, so do not engage right after Udyr activates E Stance again.
Udyr.build: Build armor first to account for Udyr’s physical damage. Udyr Q Wilding Claw deals mixed damage and Udyr R Wingborne Storm deals magic damage, so armor alone cannot block it all. If the healing from Udyr W Iron Mantle can turn a duel, get healing reduction from Morellonomicon.
Udyr.laning: Early on, focus on CS and levels instead of forcing fights. When Udyr is out of sight, do not move forward; use vision at key paths and jungle entrances to watch for gank routes. If you are pushing the lane, save Gwen W Hallowed Mist to respond to ganks.
Udyr.combo: Build Gwen Q Snip Snip! stacks first by basic attacking a minion or Udyr. Once Udyr E Blazing Stampede is down, close in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash and land an empowered basic attack, then cast Gwen Q Snip Snip! with Udyr in the center. If there is a gap between you, slow him with the first cast of Gwen R Needlework before engaging, and follow up while you can keep him in range.
Udyr.escape: Right after you make Udyr use Udyr E Blazing Stampede is your chance to close the gap with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash. If you have already been stunned once by Udyr E Blazing Stampede, use the window when the same target cannot be stunned again for a while to retaliate or escape. If you may need to disengage, check whether hitting with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash will refund its cooldown.
Udyr.phase: Since it is hard to build stacks, your trades are weak, so prioritize scaling. Your dueling gets stronger from mid game as you build ability power items, and in late game you can melt the frontline with percent max health damage. While Udyr is out of sight, do not push too far up the lane to farm.
Udyr.teamfight: Engage when Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s stun is down or Gwen W Hallowed Mist is ready. Use Gwen W Hallowed Mist to absorb focused attacks while keeping Udyr in the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!. If defensive items and Udyr W Iron Mantle’s shield make him too tanky, do not commit to attacking only Udyr; take out the weaker enemies behind him first, then finish him with your numbers advantage.
Udyr.fight: When Udyr W Iron Mantle's shield wears off, press the attack and give him no time to heal. Use your stacked Gwen Q Snip Snip! and keep Udyr in the center of the cone to deal true damage. Use Gwen W Hallowed Mist to increase your armor and magic resistance when you're taking a counterattack.

Urgot.watch: Urgot E Disdain dashes in and stuns, so watch its approach angle and dodge it. If Urgot Q Corrosive Charge hits, it slows you and Urgot W Purge focuses its shots on you, so use Gwen E Skip 'n Slash to get away. If Urgot R Fear Beyond Death hits you, get completely out of its range before your health reaches the execute threshold.
Urgot.fight: Build stacks of Gwen Q Snip Snip! with basic attacks, then use Gwen E Skip 'n Slash to close in while Urgot E Disdain is on cooldown. Cast Gwen Q Snip Snip! with Urgot in the center of the cone to deal true damage. Damage from Urgot's leg cannons accumulates if you stay near him too long, so back out beyond his short range after the trade.
Urgot.laning: Early on, focus on CS and levels instead of forcing a head-on fight. Hit minions to build stacks for Gwen Q Snip Snip!, and save Gwen W Hallowed Mist to respond to ganks when pushing the wave. If Urgot approaches with W Purge active, create distance and stay outside its firing range.
Urgot.combo: Build stacks of Gwen Q Snip Snip! first by basic attacking minions or Urgot. If Urgot E Disdain is on cooldown, slow him with the first cast of Gwen R Needlework, then use Gwen E Skip 'n Slash to close in and land an empowered basic attack. Keep Urgot in the center when you cast Gwen Q Snip Snip!. Follow up with the next cast of Gwen R Needlework when you can keep him in range.
Urgot.escape: Right after you make Urgot use his only mobility tool, Urgot E Disdain, is your window to go in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash. If Urgot Q Corrosive Charge hits and you need to get away, use Gwen E Skip 'n Slash to create distance. If Urgot R Fear Beyond Death hits you, get completely out of Urgot's range before your health reaches the execute threshold.
Urgot.phase: Focus on farming because it's difficult to build stacks and your trades are weak. Gwen's dueling gets stronger from mid game onward as you build ability power items. In late game, use your damage based on maximum health to fight the frontline directly.
Urgot.teamfight: Go in on the frontline when Urgot E Disdain is on cooldown or Gwen W Hallowed Mist is ready. Use Gwen W Hallowed Mist to avoid focused attacks from enemies outside the mist, then hit the frontline with the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip! and Gwen R Needlework. Urgot E Disdain stops at the first champion hit, so you can stand in front to block angles that would let him reach the allies behind you.
Urgot.build: Build armor first to mitigate the main damage from Urgot P Echoing Flames, Q Corrosive Charge, and W Purge. Urgot P Echoing Flames deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid choices that only greatly increase your health, and watch your total health so you can stay above Urgot R Fear Beyond Death's execution threshold.

Volibear.watch: Volibear Q Thundering Smash increases his movement speed as he approaches, then stuns with an empowered basic attack. Wait outside basic attack range, and when you see the mark from Volibear E Sky Splitter, move to the side to avoid its damage and slow. Avoid fighting while Volibear has built stacks of P The Relentless Storm by attacking minions.
Volibear.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Volibear Q Thundering Smash, W Frenzied Maul, and R Stormbringer. If healing from Volibear W Frenzied Maul turns the duel around, get healing reduction with Morellonomicon.
Volibear.fight: Build stacks of Gwen Q Snip Snip! with basic attacks before fighting. Dodge the mark from Volibear E Sky Splitter and move out of the spot where he plans to gain a shield. Then use Gwen E Skip 'n Slash to close the gap and keep Volibear in the center of Q. Continue the fight against Volibear W Frenzied Maul's healing only when you can finish him decisively.
Volibear.laning: Hit minions to build stacks for Gwen Q Snip Snip!, but avoid fighting while Volibear builds stacks of P The Relentless Storm by attacking minions. Save Gwen W Hallowed Mist for gank protection when pushing the wave.
Volibear.combo: Build stacks of Gwen Q Snip Snip! with basic attacks, then use Gwen E Skip 'n Slash to close in, land an empowered basic attack, and hit with the center of Q. If Volibear is far away, slow him with the first cast of Gwen R Needlework, then approach with E. Continue casting R while Volibear remains in range.
Volibear.escape: Once Volibear Q Thundering Smash's approach and stun have been used up, you have a chance to go in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash. If Volibear R Stormbringer has also been used, take advantage of the opening while he has fewer ways to approach again. If only Q has been used up, check whether R is still available.
Volibear.phase: Early on, Gwen has trouble building stacks of Q Snip Snip!, so focus on scaling instead of forcing fights with Volibear. Gwen's dueling gets stronger from mid game onward as you build ability power items. In late game, use your damage based on maximum health to fight Volibear on the frontline directly.
Volibear.teamfight: If Volibear has stacks of P The Relentless Storm, wait for them to fall off before fighting. When Volibear Q Thundering Smash's stun has been used up or Gwen W Hallowed Mist is ready, go in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash and hit with the center of Q. If Volibear R Stormbringer is available, don't stay under your turret at low health, and move away from its landing spot too.

Yorick.watch: Yorick E Mourning Mist slows, marks, and deals damage based on your maximum health, so watch the projectile's path and dodge it. If you're trapped in Yorick W Dark Procession, hit the wall to break it or cross over with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash. If the Maiden of the Mist marks Gwen, Yorick's basic attacks deal additional damage, so create distance from Yorick himself.
Yorick.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Yorick Q Last Rites and his ghouls. Yorick E Mourning Mist and R Eulogy of the Isles deal damage based on your maximum health, so be cautious about relying on a large health pool alone. If healing from Yorick Q Last Rites turns the duel around, get healing reduction with Morellonomicon.
Yorick.fight: Dodge Yorick E Mourning Mist, then use Gwen E Skip 'n Slash to close the gap. Before going in, build stacks of Gwen Q Snip Snip! with basic attacks, then cast it with Yorick in the center of the cone. Avoid dueling Yorick himself while he has many ghouls or while the Maiden of the Mist's mark remains on Gwen.
Yorick.laning: Early on, focus on CS and levels rather than forcing trades, and build stacks for Gwen Q Snip Snip!. Push the wave so Yorick can't build graves by clearing minions on his side, but save Gwen W Hallowed Mist for gank protection while pushing. Step forward to farm when Yorick E Mourning Mist misses.
Yorick.combo: Build stacks of Gwen Q Snip Snip! first by basic attacking minions or Yorick. If he's far away, slow him with the first cast of Gwen R Needlework, then use Gwen E Skip 'n Slash to close in and land an empowered basic attack. Cast Gwen Q Snip Snip! with Yorick in the center, and continue using Gwen R Needlework when you can keep him in range.
Yorick.escape: Right after Yorick E Mourning Mist misses, you have a chance to go in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash. If Yorick W Dark Procession is on cooldown, there's less risk of getting trapped in its wall, so go in with stacks of Gwen Q Snip Snip! ready.
Yorick.phase: Early on, Gwen's trades are weak because it's hard to build stacks of Q Snip Snip!, so focus on scaling. Her dueling gets stronger from mid game onward as she builds ability power items. Look for a chance to fight Yorick himself while the Maiden of the Mist is alone in a side lane. In late game, use Gwen's damage based on maximum health to attack the enemy frontline.
Yorick.teamfight: Gwen uses the center of Q Snip Snip! on the frontline. Go in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash when the enemy's key crowd control is on cooldown or Gwen W Hallowed Mist is ready. If you can clear Yorick's ghouls first, do so before fighting.

Yone.watch: If Yone repeatedly uses Q Mortal Steel on minions to prepare his tornado, move out of range and wait for the stacks to disappear. After Yone E Soul Unbound brings him in, he can deal additional damage when he returns, so create distance before your health gets low. Yone R Fate Sealed pulls in enemies along its path, so move away from its telegraphed area.
Yone.build: The first item to purchase can't be specified because the source material doesn't provide it. Yone Q Mortal Steel deals physical damage, while Yone P Way of the Hunter deals magic damage, so consider both armor and magic resistance. Yone W Spirit Cleave deals damage based on your maximum health, so be careful about building health alone.
Yone.fight: Build stacks of Gwen Q Snip Snip! with basic attacks, then start the trade once Yone's tornado has disappeared. Use Gwen E Skip 'n Slash to close in and land an empowered basic attack, then cast Gwen Q Snip Snip! with Yone in the center. When Yone tries to basic attack from outside the mist, respond with Gwen W Hallowed Mist.
Yone.laning: Hit minions to build stacks, but keep your distance if Yone has readied his tornado with Q Mortal Steel. Save Gwen W Hallowed Mist for gank protection when pushing the wave.
Yone.combo: Build stacks of Gwen Q Snip Snip! first by basic attacking minions or Yone. Use Gwen E Skip 'n Slash to close in and land an empowered basic attack, then cast Gwen Q Snip Snip! with Yone in the center. If Yone is far away, slow him with the first cast of Gwen R Needlework, then approach with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash.
Yone.escape: Your window to go in is after Yone's Q Mortal Steel tornado disappears and before Yone R Fate Sealed comes back up. If Yone E Soul Unbound is also on cooldown, it's a good time to close the gap with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash. If only one of Yone's mobility abilities is on cooldown, he can still escape with the other, so keep track of both.
Yone.phase: Both champions have weak periods early on, but Gwen shouldn't force trades without stacks of Q Snip Snip!. Gwen's dueling gets stronger from mid game onward as you build ability power items. In late game, use Gwen's damage based on maximum health to fight the frontline.
Yone.teamfight: Gwen goes in when the enemy's key crowd control is on cooldown or Gwen W Hallowed Mist is ready, then hits the frontline with the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!. Keep your distance from allies so you don't all get hit by Yone W Spirit Cleave. Yone R Fate Sealed moves him behind the last champion hit, so check whether you're at the back of your formation.

Yasuo.watch: Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has a narrow hitbox, so move out of its line and sidestep as it approaches. After he hits twice with Q, his next Q sends out a tornado that knocks you up, so watch and listen for its tell and prepare. Also watch out for Yasuo R Last Breath, which includes an airborne effect.
Yasuo.build: Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and R Last Breath deal mostly physical damage, so buy armor items first. Gwen W Hallowed Mist also grants armor. Armor cannot block the magic damage from Yasuo E Sweeping Blade.
Yasuo.fight: Build stacks for Gwen Q Snip Snip! with basic attacks on minions before fighting. Trigger Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield by dealing damage first, then trade in earnest after its short duration ends. Right after Yasuo throws his tornado, close the gap with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash and hit him with the center of Q.
Yasuo.combo: Build stacks for Gwen Q Snip Snip! with basic attacks on minions. After Yasuo’s tornado is gone, slow him with the first cast of Gwen R Needlework, close in with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash, land an empowered basic attack, then center Q on Yasuo. If he remains in range, continue casting R.
Yasuo.escape: The moment after Yasuo throws the tornado from Q Steel Tempest is your chance to engage. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade has a short cooldown, so don’t chase in just because he used it once. If Yasuo R Last Breath is not ready yet, close the gap with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash.
Yasuo.phase: Your dueling gets stronger from mid game as you build ability power items. In late game, use your percent max health damage to attack the frontline.
Yasuo.teamfight: Gwen attacks the frontline and hits the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip! Engage with Gwen E Skip 'n Slash when the enemy’s key crowd control is on cooldown or Gwen W Hallowed Mist is ready. Use W to respond to focused attacks, and continue casting Gwen R Needlework on enemies in range.
Yasuo.laning: Don't force trades early; focus on CS and levels. Manage the wave so a thin wave pushes toward your side, reducing the number of minions Yasuo can use to dash in with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. When pushing the lane, save Gwen W Hallowed Mist to protect yourself from ganks.
